name: 陳家興
objective:
This course integrates information visualization, interactive web programming, cloud databases, Internet of Things (IoT) technologies, smart floor sensing systems, Generative AI, and Agentic AI to develop students’ abilities in designing and implementing smart space interactive systems.
Using a project-based learning approach, students will begin with front-end web development and progressively learn JavaScript programming, Apache ECharts data visualization, Firebase cloud database integration, Arduino-based sensor data acquisition, and smart floor sensing system applications. The course further introduces Gemini API, Prompt Engineering, and Agentic AI technologies to develop Smart Space Agents capable of environmental sensing, contextual analysis, and autonomous decision-making.
The course emphasizes practical implementation and interdisciplinary integration across interaction design, information visualization, artificial intelligence, and smart space applications. Through hands-on projects, students will gain experience in developing intelligent interactive systems for smart space and smart healthcare environments.
---------------------------------------------------------------
本課程結合資訊視覺化、互動式網頁程式設計、雲端資料庫、物聯網感測技術、智慧地墊系統、生成式人工智慧（Generative AI）及 Agentic AI，培養學生設計與開發智慧空間互動系統的能力。
課程採專題導向學習（Project-Based Learning），學生將從網頁前端開發開始，逐步學習 JavaScript 程式設計、Apache ECharts 資訊視覺化、Firebase 雲端資料庫整合、Arduino 感測器資料擷取，以及智慧地墊系統之資料分析與應用。後續透過 Gemini API、Prompt Engineering 與 Agentic AI 技術，建構具備環境感知、情境分析與自主決策能力的智慧空間代理人（Smart Space Agent）。
課程以智慧空間與智慧照護應用為主要情境，透過實作與專題開發，培養學生在互動設計、資料視覺化、人工智慧及智慧空間系統整合等跨領域能力。

延伸教學與資源: ● 參與式創新教學 (Participatory & Innovative Teaching) 強調學生參與與產出，導入翻轉、PBL/專題、設計思考或遊戲化等策略。Emphasizes student engagement and outcomes by adopting strategies such as Flipped Classroom, PBL (Problem/Project- Based Learning), Design Thinking, or Gamification.● 數位科技融入 (Digital Technology Integration) 運用生成式 AI、VR/AR、IoT、IRS 等新興科技輔助教學與評量。Utilizes emerging technologies such as Generative AI, VR/AR, IoT, and IRS (Interactive Response Systems) to facilitate teaching and assessment.
課程對應SDGs指標: SDG4：優質教育（Quality Education）SDG9：產業創新與基礎設施（Industry, Innovation and Infrastructure）SDG11：永續城市與社區（Sustainable Cities and Communities）
課程是否導入AI: ● 使用生成式 AI 作為教學過程的輔助工具（Use generative AI tools as an aid to the teaching process）● 鼓勵學生使用生成式 AI 工具（Encourage students to use generative AI tools）● 簡單介紹 AI 的基本概念（Briefly introduce the basic concept of AI）
